messages:
maria: Noticed a bunch of nodes in eu-west lost OOB after last night's unattended BMC firmware push. can anyone confirm?
raj: yep, seeing ~12 hosts stuck with console unavailable. IPMI ping times out. :grimacing:
oliver: what firmware version did we push?
maria: BMC v2.14.7 -> v2.15.0 via device-manager auto-rollout at 02:00 UTC.
jana: deploy-bot FYI: auto-rollout triggered per policy `bmc-auto-updates`
sre-bot: automated message: rollout completed 02:12 UTC, 120/132 succeeded, 12 failed -> state=unreachable
raj: logs show BMC switched to secureboot ON during upgrade on those hosts. they rebooted into a vendor prompt and didn't come back.
oliver: can you paste the serial console snippet?
raj: here, truncated:
```
BootROM v3.1
Secure Boot: Enabled
Loading boot image...
ERROR: Platform auth required
Press F1 to enter setup
```

maria: remote KVM isn't responding either. looks like IPMI got into a mode where network listener closed. not just a kernel hang.
jana: ops note: these hosts are in the gpu-pool with 8xA100 each. impacted capacity ~96 GPUs (~6% of total). customers in eu-west experiencing queued jobs.
oliver: quick mitigation: we should patch device-manager to stop auto-updates, then plan manual BMC rollback cadence. can someone fence the nodes and reprovision from spare pool?
raj: fencing attempt failed because BMC IPMI isn't reachable. need vendor OOB (iDRAC/iLO) serial-over-lan fix or on-site tech.
maria: i've opened vendor ticket with DCS support. ETA for tech swap ~4-6 hours for eu-west colo.
jana: capacity hit will cost us burst credits on Dedicated clusters if queued jobs get routed to other regions. ops @finance FYI.
oliver: temporary workaround: mark impacted hosts as `drain` in scheduler to avoid new job placement. i'll run: `rb-sched drain --hosts $(cat stuck_hosts.txt)`
raj: done. no new jobs scheduled, current jobs will timeout in 30-60m.
maria: propose updating rollout policy: disable secure-boot toggle in BMC firmware upgrades until vendor confirms it won't flip flag. also add pre-upgrade check for OOB console availability.
jana: agreed. also add a health-check that validates SOL session post-upgrade.
oliver: creating a quick PR to patch device-manager config and add a canary batch size 1 for BMC upgrades. will annotate with incident link.
raj: can we get a temp reassign of jobs to other regions? engage scheduler-owner?
jana: pinged @sre on pager, they're standing by to adjust cross-region routing if needed.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-112 (BMC firmware -> OOB unreachable, eu-west). assigned: eng-infra oncall.
maria: thanks. i'll keep updates here and paste vendor responses. if tech confirms console reattach steps we can try remote first to avoid swap. :crossed_fingers:
